mitre_attack.rationale: Traffic pattern is consistent with systematic probing across sequential destination ports within short temporal windows.

observed_heuristics: Elevated SYN packet ratio without handshake completion (SYN/ACK: 6.2)

top_features.human_text: Elevated unanswered connection initiation attempts (probing / SYN flood)
Systematic probing across multiple target destination ports
Rapid surge in total connections per window
High ratio of ordered port probing detected
Unstable TTL variance indicative of potential source spoofing

explainability.summary_text: Forecasted risk (HIGH 86%) is primarily driven by TCP SYN Activity and Destination Port Diversity consistent with network reconnaissance.

recommendations.title: Investigate Source Host for Systematic Service Scanning
recommendations.description: Audit host active processes and socket connections. Inspect whether host is executing nmap, masscan, or custom scanning scripts.
recommendations.command_example: ss -tulpn | grep LISTEN ; ps aux | grep -E '(nmap|scan|nc)'

recommendations.title: Enforce Dynamic Rate Limiting & Firewall Ingress Filter
recommendations.description: Temporarily rate-limit SYN packet burst from source IP at perimeter firewall or host iptables to neutralize reconnaissance.
recommendations.command_example: iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN,ACK,FIN,RST SYN -m limit --limit 5/s --limit-burst 10 -j ACCEPT

recommendations.title: Close Unused Perimeter Ports & Enable TCP SYN Cookies
recommendations.description: Ensure non-essential listening services are disabled and TCP SYN cookies are enabled to prevent socket exhaustion.
